messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning an RBAC + netpol hardening for Tenant 'Skyline' on the next private deploy. Goal: stricter agent SA roles, block pod-to-pod egress except explicit backends, and require KMS auth via scoped service identity. Need quick sanity-checks and migration notes.

jamie: +1. Can you list the SA role drops? worried about model-worker write perms to the audit bucket.

maria: Current plan: remove wide storage:write, keep storage:read for model-worker; introduce dedicated signer SA for decrypt ops. We'll map old SA -> new SA via a short-lived token bridge for rollout.

lee: Netpol question: when we block pod egress, how do we keep connectivity to customer KMS (onprem HSM) during key rotation? We saw flakiness in last test.

maria: Good catch. Proposal: allowlist narrow IPs/ports for the KMS cluster and add a background reconnecter in the keystore shim that retries with exponential backoff. Also keep local encrypted cache of recent DEKs (decrypt keys) for read-only inference during transient KMS outages. Not full fail-open — reads only and audit log the fallback.

irina: For audit logs: we need per-tenant encryption of logs at rest (KMS-wrapped) and an immutable append-only stream. Also include a warning event whenever the fallback cache is used. Ops needs a signal for incident response.

jamie: On the RBAC migration, can we do canary on 10% of nodes first and run an eval set to confirm nothing breaks? Rollback plan if we see 5% error spike.

maria: Exactly — canary + golden prompts. Also suggest a rollout window with packet-capture off by default to avoid PII leakage.

lee: CVE triage: there was a sidecar sandbox escape in a 3rd-party repo last month. If we tighten netpol but still mount hostPath for metrics, we might expose a vector. Recommend remove hostPath metrics and run exporter as daemonset with hostNetwork false.

irina: Agree. Also add a periodic audit that checks for any hostPath mounts in tenant namespaces and fail preflight.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: RBAC ruleset v2 applied? NO. Netpols staged? NO. KMS allowlist updated? PENDING. Canary nodes: 0/10.

maria: Action items: 1) jamie to draft RBAC delta yaml and canary plan, 2) lee to update netpol + KMS allowlist and keystore shim retry logic, 3) irina to add audit events for fallback cache + hostPath preflight, 4) ops to schedule canary next Tue 09:00 UTC. If we hit >5% inference error or any decrypt failures, rollback immediately.

jamie: I'll also add a short-term mitigation: a read-only circuit-breaker that returns 429 instead of degrading silent outputs when KMS fails — prefer explicit errors to bad model outputs.

maria: Thanks. If anyone sees an edge-case (e.g., customers behind bespoke NAT) post the example IP ranges — we'll add exception rules but try to keep the attack surface minimal.

lee: One more: document the incident playbook for KMS compromise — assume fail-closed by default, but have a documented emergency decrypt key escrow flow (with 2-person approval) to restore business-critical reads. I'll draft.

irina: I'll wire the audit alert to oncall and add a runbook step to rotate tenant DEKs and validate model signatures.

maria: Perfect. We'll reconvene after the YAML PRs land. :thumbsup:
